## Checklist

- [ ] Tests run and pass: `py -3 -m pytest` (or `py -3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`)
- [ ] Documentation updated for any behaviour or interface change
- [ ] No fabricated data: every reported number comes from code or data in this repository, or is clearly labelled as illustrative
- [ ] Benchmark numbers are reproducible: the command, seed, and software/hardware environment are stated
- [ ] GPL-3.0-or-later licence header kept on new source files
